title: Product Bioactive Relationships
description: Product-to-canonical-bioactive relationships, built against manufacturer factsheets. Plays the same role for products that food-bioactives.json plays for foods, plugging into the same bioactive-mechanisms.json / mechanisms.json / body-systems-mechanisms.json chain.

id.description: Must match an id in bioactives.json.

status.description: DIRECT: the compound itself (or its declared source at a stated dose) appears on the factsheet. SOURCE_DEFINED: present via a named source ingredient characteristic of this compound, without an independently declared amount.
